questions.q: How long should you spend on a 4-mark question?
questions.model: Paper 1 is a mark a minute. 4 marks means about 4 minutes. Then move on.

questions.a: Two reasons, each developed: heavy rain plus saturated soil; urban surfaces increasing run-off and shortening lag time
